prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: editorial featured-image illustration for two local indoor volleyball news articles. Create an original, clearly illustrated wide 16:9 indoor volleyball scene: one unbranded white volleyball in foreground on a polished hardwood indoor court, a regulation volleyball net and neutral gym bleachers receding softly behind it. No people, no school logos, no team colors, no readable names, no scores, no sand, no beach, no outdoors. Elegant editorial painted illustration with subtle paper texture, natural gym lighting and clear court lines. It must obviously be artwork, not an event photograph. Add small legible text in a neutral lower corner reading exactly ILLUSTRATION. Do not depict or claim any actual match, school, or venue. Medium-blue and warm wood accents, uncluttered composition that crops well as a news thumbnail.
